reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!!!
reviews.text:
SPYPOINT — absolutely unacceptable product quality and even worse customer service.

I rarely take the time to write reviews like this, but SPYPOINT has wasted enough of my time that other customers deserve to know what they may be getting into.

I deployed two of SPYPOINT’s higher-end cellular trail cameras with their solar setup and LIT-22 rechargeable batteries. Both cameras failed in less than three months.

They worked great initially. Then one simply stopped transmitting, and shortly afterward the second did the same. There was no useful indication in the app that the cameras had actually quit functioning — they just stopped sending pictures.

When I went out to service them, I discovered something even more ridiculous. On one camera, the plastic locking mechanism for the cover literally fell off as soon as I tried to release it. Then I opened the cover and the COVER ITSELF FELL OFF.

The plastic around the hinge/attachment points appeared to have become so brittle from outdoor exposure that it simply broke apart.

Think about that for a moment: an outdoor trail camera, specifically designed to sit outside in the elements, physically deteriorated to the point that pieces fell off when touched — in LESS THAN THREE MONTHS.

But the product failure wasn’t even the worst part.

Trying to get SPYPOINT customer service to stand behind it was an absolute nightmare. Their online chat became an endless loop of representatives peppering me with questions, disappearing to supposed

reviews.title: So many flaws FOR YEARS with no improvement
reviews.text:
The only things SpyPoint has going for it is that you get 100 free pictures a month. 
1. The quality is very low. 
2. You have to go online to make purchases, you cannot do it within the app. 
3. You have to check off each camera individually to look at all of the photos because they're not smart enough to put a "Select all" feature so that you can easily choose all of your cameras. 
4. When placing cameras on the map, it will only show six of my 12 cameras. It will not allow me to put half of my cameras on the map because it doesn't show that they exist in the map feature, even though they're in the app everywhere else.
5. Cameras will randomly just fail, so don't expect a long lifespan with them.

reviews.title: New 7/23/26 app sux
reviews.text: Why did Spypoint change their app? Don’t give me the 7646 number to call as I have already spoken to them and they have been unhelpful.  They changed the format of the app without even having to update it manually. All the Font size is now super difficult to read, and they changed the battery meter. Battery meter no longer shows a percentage rather it shows a five bar system. I’ve been doing extensive testing with my voltmeter and how it compares to the five meter. Using AA alkaline my flex M series camera are showing medium level battery with three bars and a nominal voltage of 10.62 V, which equals to 1.32v per cell. On the flex M in the system settings, you can only choose between aa lithiums as the power source or auto.  My camera is set for Auto. There is now way that 10.66 v could be medium battery left. I’m giving this app review a one star but I would give it zero if possible.  I can’t believe you didn’t do a beta test first for rolling this out.
